config.tacz.client.key.hold_to_aim.desc: Hold the aim key while aiming. When disabled, pressing it toggles aiming.
config.tacz.client.key.hold_to_crawl.des: Hold the crawl key to stay prone. When disabled, pressing it toggles your stance.
config.tacz.client.key.auto_reload.desc: Attempt to reload when firing an empty weapon.
Fade laser sight beams with distance.
config.tacz.client.render.gun_lod_render: Prefer the pack's simplified model beyond this distance. Use the normal model if none is supplied.
config.tacz.client.render.bullet_hole_pa: Bullet hole particle lifetime in game ticks. Normally, 20 ticks is about one second.
Fraction of the lifetime consumed before fading starts, from 0 to 1.
config.tacz.client.render.crosshair_type: Select the crosshair used outside aiming. A style needs its corresponding texture in the active resources.
config.tacz.client.render.hit_market_sta: Adjust the hit marker's initial offset from the screen center.
config.tacz.client.render.head_shot_debu: Show headshot detection regions for hit-position debugging.
config.tacz.client.render.gun_hud_enable: Show the current weapon, ammunition and fire mode on screen.
config.tacz.client.render.scope_mask_ena: Prevent the first-person gun body from obstructing the scope view.
config.tacz.client.render.kill_amount_en: Display the gun kill counter notification.
config.tacz.client.render.kill_amount_du: Number of seconds to keep the kill counter visible.
config.tacz.client.render.target_render_: Rendering distance for shooting targets and related models, in blocks.
config.tacz.client.render.first_person_b: Show your tracers in first person. The weapon must also have tracers enabled.
config.tacz.client.render.disable_intera: Hide the on-screen gun interaction key hints.
config.tacz.client.render.auto_select_gu: Select recipes related to the held weapon when opening the workbench.
config.tacz.client.render.damage_counter: Wait time before resetting accumulated damage, in milliseconds.
config.tacz.client.render.disable_moveme: Suppress field-of-view changes caused by gun movement-speed attributes.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_tooltip: Include resource identifiers in gun, ammo and attachment tooltips.
config.tacz.client.render.enable_translu: Allow related block entities to use translucent rendering.
config.tacz.client.resource.enable_lazy_: Load Models and Animations on Demand
Load model and animation runtime data when needed to reduce concentrated startup work.
config.tacz.client.sound.hit_sound_concu: Maximum concurrent sounds of the same hit type. Set to 0 for no limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.default_sound_c: Maximum concurrent sounds of the same normal gun sound type. Set to 0 for no limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.high_frequency_: Maximum concurrent high-frequency sounds such as gunfire. Set to 0 for no limit.
config.tacz.client.sound.first_person_an: Make the positions of first-person animation sounds follow the player.
config.tacz.client.zoom.screen_distance_: Adjust the coefficient used to calculate aiming screen distance.
config.tacz.client.zoom.zoom_sensitivity: Apply this multiplier to base mouse sensitivity while aiming.
config.tacz.common.gun.default_gun_fire_: Base range of unsuppressed gunshots, in blocks.
config.tacz.common.gun.default_gun_silen: Base range of suppressed gunshots, in blocks.
config.tacz.common.gun.default_gun_other: Base range of reload, draw and other action sounds, in blocks.
config.tacz.common.gun.creative_player_c: Choose whether creative players need to consume ammunition when using guns.
config.tacz.common.gun.auto_reload_when_: Automatically attempt a weapon reload after respawning.
config.tacz.common.ammo.explosive_ammo_d: Allow explosive ammunition blasts to destroy blocks.
config.tacz.common.ammo.explosive_ammo_f: Allow explosive ammunition blasts to create fire.
config.tacz.common.ammo.explosive_ammo_k: Allow explosive ammunition to knock entities back.
config.tacz.common.ammo.explosive_ammo_v: Visibility distance of explosive ammunition effects, in blocks.
config.tacz.common.ammo.pass_through_blo: Configure the list of block identifiers that bullets can pass through.
config.tacz.common.ammo.destroy_glass.de: Allow bullet impacts to destroy supported glass blocks.
config.tacz.common.ammo.ignite_block.des: Allow ammunition with ignition effects to ignite blocks.
config.tacz.common.ammo.ignite_entity.de: Allow ammunition with ignition effects to ignite entities.
config.tacz.common.ammo.global_speed_mod: Multiply the base projectile speed by this value.
config.tacz.common.other.default_pack_de: Control whether built-in pack export overwrites existing files, for resource debugging.
config.tacz.common.other.target_sound_di: Range of shooting-target hit sounds, in blocks.
